$ srv --help
Serve the store.

USAGE
  srv <command> [options]

COMMANDS
  serve              Run the server of the store.
  migrate            Migrate the store to the current schema.

OPTIONS
  -c, --config file  Config file in JSON.
                     env SRV_CONFIG
      --flag-debug   Print the value and the source of each option before the
                     command runs.
                     env SRV_FLAG_DEBUG
  -h, --help         Show the help.
[exit 0]

$ srv serve --help
Run the server of the store.

USAGE
  srv serve [options] [STORE]

ARGUMENTS
  STORE               Name of the store.
                      default "main"

OPTIONS
  -a, --addr string   Address to listen on.
                      default ":8080" · env SRV_SERVE_ADDR · key serve.addr
      --client-certificate-authority string
                      Certificate authority of the clients.
                      env SRV_SERVE_CLIENT_CERTIFICATE_AUTHORITY
                      key serve.client-certificate-authority
  -q, --quiet         Do not log the requests.
                      env SRV_SERVE_QUIET · key serve.quiet
      --token string  Bearer token of the requests.
                      required · env SRV_SERVE_TOKEN · key serve.token

GLOBAL OPTIONS
  -c, --config file   Config file in JSON.
                      env SRV_CONFIG
      --flag-debug    Print the value and the source of each option before the
                      command runs.
                      env SRV_FLAG_DEBUG
  -h, --help          Show the help.
[exit 0]

$ COLUMNS=60 srv serve --help
Run the server of the store.

USAGE
  srv serve [options] [STORE]

ARGUMENTS
  STORE               Name of the store.
                      default "main"

OPTIONS
  -a, --addr string   Address to listen on.
                      default ":8080" · env SRV_SERVE_ADDR
                      key serve.addr
      --client-certificate-authority string
                      Certificate authority of the clients.
                      env SRV_SERVE_CLIENT_CERTIFICATE_AUTHORITY
                      key serve.client-certificate-authority
  -q, --quiet         Do not log the requests.
                      env SRV_SERVE_QUIET · key serve.quiet
      --token string  Bearer token of the requests.
                      required · env SRV_SERVE_TOKEN
                      key serve.token

GLOBAL OPTIONS
  -c, --config file   Config file in JSON.
                      env SRV_CONFIG
      --flag-debug    Print the value and the source of each
                      option before the command runs.
                      env SRV_FLAG_DEBUG
  -h, --help          Show the help.
[exit 0]

$ srv serve --adr :9000
srv: serve: unknown flag --adr (did you mean --addr?)
[exit 2]

$ srv serve
srv: serve: missing --token
[exit 2]

$ SRV_SERVE_TOKEN=s3cret srv serve store-2 --flag-debug
  OPTION                          VALUE      SOURCE
  --config                        ""         default
  --addr                          ":8080"    default
  --client-certificate-authority  ""         default
  --quiet                         false      default
  --token                         ***        env SRV_SERVE_TOKEN
  STORE                           "store-2"  argument STORE
serve store-2 on :8080
[exit 0]

$ srv migrate -n
plan: no migration
[exit 0]

$ srv migrate >/dev/full
srv: main: write the result: clitest: no space left on device
[exit 1]
